# LORUNEI URL redirects

Compatibility for existing published URLs. The canonical site is https://lorunei.github.io/personal-japan-trip-planning/index.html.

Publish main / root through GitHub Pages. Keep the original project path available so previously shared links and payment-return URLs continue to work. Query parameters and fragments are preserved. Payment-return pages retain their original public form content as a fallback while the lowercase deployment is becoming available.

No Stripe account settings or payment-processing configuration are stored here.
